[ 01 / PROJECT OVERVIEW ]MADE FOR PEOPLE.

Project overview.

NOX brings together graphite surfaces, acid-green accents and cinematic chrome-and-emerald visuals. Markets, a converter, allocation exploration and educational tools give visitors several ways to understand the offering.

THE PEOPLE

Visitors exploring digital assets and looking for understandable context before choosing what to inspect next.

THE SCOPE

Responsive website design, visual direction, market-chart states, a conversion calculator, allocation explorer, order-book explainer and learning checklist.

THE STATUS

Design concept.
UX/UI and interaction design.

[ 02 / THE PROBLEM ]MADE FOR PEOPLE.

The problem.

Crypto information can feel like a stream of prices without enough context. Visitors need to understand what an asset view, an amount or an allocation represents. A visually distinctive platform also needs to distinguish sample exploration from live market activity, trading and security guarantees.

[ 03 / THE SOLUTION ]MADE FOR PEOPLE.

The solution.

Give visitors a clear progression from discovery to understanding. Pair asset selection with sample charts and timeframes, translate amounts through a straightforward converter and use an allocation explorer to show a bigger picture. Explain bids, asks and spread visually, then add a learning checklist and contextual labels that keep illustrative data distinct from real transactions.

[ 04 / DESIGN PRIORITIES ]MADE FOR PEOPLE.

A few priorities.
A clearer direction.

Three priorities that guide the experience.

01

See beyond the ticker.

Compare assets in one view and give every sample price more context.

02

Make the numbers click.

Use a straightforward conversion to make an amount easier to understand.

03

Stay intentional.

Separate exploration and education from real transactions or promises.

[ 08 / REFLECTION & VALIDATION ]MADE FOR PEOPLE.

Designed with intent.
Open to learning.

The concept demonstrates website and interaction design using sample data. Clarity, comprehension and responsive behaviour are areas to evaluate; no trading performance or user-research result is claimed.

  • Select an asset and understand a chart timeframe.
  • Explain the converter’s fixed sample rate.
  • Distinguish allocation illustration from a recommendation.
  • Identify bids, asks and the spread.

All prices, charts, order levels and allocation examples are illustrative. No trades are placed. The checklist does not secure or verify a wallet.
